text: Like the other whey cheeses, no rennet or acid: heat flocculates the proteins, and the added cream is what makes manouri creamier than feta. Protected designation of origin (Greek specification of 1994), made mainly in Thessaly and Macedonia.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Curd grains are strained out of the ricotta.
Enough is added to bring the fat to at least 2.5 %.
Salt, about 1 %, is added, with milk or cream up to 25 %.
